meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 装上此技能后,Claude能通过Figma API读取你给的Figma文件,生成包含页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例、设计令牌等节点的交互式设计知识图谱,并自动打开“design”看板展示。
howto.when: 当你提供Figma文件链接或文件key时触发;若未配置FIGMA_TOKEN,会先提示你设置后再继续。

say.note: 生成设计知识图谱并打开看板。
无需完整链接,直接用key分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph covering pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, and design tokens, then launch a "design" dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a Figma file URL or file key. If FIGMA_TOKEN is not set, Claude stops and asks you to configure it first.

say_en.note: Generates the design graph and opens the dashboard.

say_en.text: Analyze this Figma file in Chinese: https://figma.com/file/abc
say_en.note: Uses Chinese for the generated graph.

say_en.text: Analyze the Figma file with key abc123
say_en.note: Uses the file key directly instead of a full URL.
